title: ConnectorEnvelope
description: Outer wire message for the connector<->dispatch stream. Every frame sent in either direction over the persistent outbound connection uses this shape. The payload schema is selected by 'kind'.

protocol_version.description: Wire protocol version. Bump on any breaking change to envelope or payload shapes.

message_id.description: Unique id for this exact message, used for ack/idempotency.

job_id.description: The job this message belongs to. Null only for connection-level 'error' messages not tied to a specific job.

kind.description: job: dispatch->connector, new work offer. action: dispatch->connector, one instructed step. result: connector->dispatch, structured outcome. ack: either direction, confirms receipt. terminal: dispatch->connector, job is done. error: either direction, protocol or connection failure.

payload.description: Validated against the payload schema selected by kind.
